parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

parameters.name: Ids
parameters.description: The IDs of the rules to be deleted.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The microservice namespace to which the application belongs.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse delete-flow-rules --namespace default --ids 1 --app-name spring-cloud-a --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse DeleteFlowRules --region cn-hangzhou --Ids '[1]' --AcceptLanguage zh --Namespace default --AppName 'spring-cloud-a'
